LanguageData.RR_Event_CorridorUnmarked: The corridor seems to repeat, and there is nothing marking room {0}. Set a glow pod down at that junction and mark it as the route home, then come back and compare.
LanguageData.RR_Field_CannotRecover: Select an upright expedition worker at the site with somewhere clear to set things down.
LanguageData.RR_UI_RecoverRoutePlacement: Recover equipment retained after interrupted placement
LanguageData.RR_Event_AccountsDisagree: {0}: {1} does not place the displaced marker where the record already puts it. Both accounts are on file and the evidence readout names them. Two crew who disagree about one room is itself worth reporting.
LanguageData.RR_Event_CorridorMismatch: {0}: a door repeats the last room’s label, but the route counter disagrees. Stop and compare the markers a crew has actually placed. The last validated junction is room {1}; a numbered marker there identifies the safe route, and the coordinate’s own return threshold is the way out. Continuing deeper risks a loop.
LanguageData.RR_Event_CorridorCountered: Tag and beacon agree at room {0}. The crew identified the false connection and preserved the return path.
LanguageData.RR_Event_CorridorLoop: The door returned the crew to room {0}. Three reported in-game minutes were lost; no injury occurred and the gate exit is unchanged.
LanguageData.RR_Event_CorridorRouteBlocked: The last junction is obstructed. The route distortion stopped without moving the crew. Clear the route or request recall.
LanguageData.RR_Event_PursuerSighting: Quiet Pursuer reported in room {0}, {1} rooms away. Keep moving along your route, retreat behind a closed door, or prepare to repel it. The threshold remains safe.
LanguageData.RR_Event_PursuerAdvance: The figure is now in room {0}, about {1} connected rooms from the nearest crew member.
LanguageData.RR_Event_PursuerContactWarning: The figure is in the same room as {0}. Move away or repel it now. Contact may occur after one further reported in-game minute.
LanguageData.RR_Event_PursuerInjury: {0} was struck once and injured. The figure withdrew. Assess the wound and use ordinary medical treatment.
LanguageData.RR_Event_PursuerRepelled: The attack forced the figure back to room {0}. The crew has another warning interval to withdraw.
LanguageData.RR_Event_PursuerWithdrawn: The figure withdrew. This opening will not spawn another encounter.
LanguageData.RR_UI_RecoverEvidence: Order {0} to collect the record book
LanguageData.RR_UI_FieldObjectives: Survey the six required room families with the record book, document the route mismatch, carry the book home and shelve it in the records archive. A clear entity observation and all three original crew returning qualify for the bonus. Set glow pods down at known junctions and designate them as route markers to counter the loop.
LanguageData.RR_Event_PursuerPlacementFailed: The encounter could not be placed safely. No entity sighting was recorded. The crew and saved route remain available; consult the game log before a later visit.
